annotations.title: Post a job on my listing

description: Submit a job opening on one of the user's listings (the listing needs active Pro perks; up to 5 open or pending roles). Like the dashboard form, it goes to moderation first and is published after approval. Requires the user's confirmation.

apply_url.description: Full https:// link to the job post or careers page.

confirmation_token.description: Leave empty on the first call: you get an action_summary and a token instead of the action. After the user explicitly confirms that summary, call again with the SAME arguments plus this token.

listing.description: One of the user's own listings.

name: post_job
